content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Notification 2026 PDF Out
content_sections.text: The notification invites online applications for 1 Wireman post with a Pay Matrix of ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 plus applicable allowances. The online application process starts on 12 August 2026 at 12:00 PM and closes on 31 August 2026 at 11:59 PM. content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The High Court has mentioned that the examination schedule may be changed in unavoidable circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The High Court of Gujarat has announced only 1 Wireman (Group-C) vacancy under this recruitment drive. As only one vacancy is available, reservation policy will not be applicable. The notification states that unreserved category criteria will apply for selection purposes.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification, language knowledge, computer knowledge and work experience conditions mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: The required qualification should be possessed on the last date of online application.

rows.educational_qualification: Candidate must have passed Wireman Course from Industrial Training Institute (ITI). Knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi and English languages is required. Computer knowledge as prescribed by the Government is required.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Experience Requirement 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have work experience as a Wireman in a Public Sector Undertaking or reputed organisation/company. Minimum required experience: 1 year Experience should be as a Wireman. The experience requirement is mentioned in the official notification under Work Experience criteria.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit will be calculated as on the last date of online application.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Age Relaxation 2026
content_sections.text: The High Court of Gujarat provides age relaxation benefits to eligible categories as per Government rules and applicable provisions. The notification states that after considering all applicable age relaxations, the candidate's age should not exceed 45 years as on the last date of online application.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: The selected candidate for the Wireman (Group-C) post will receive salary as per the Pay Matrix prescribed by the High Court of Gujarat. The salary details are mentioned in the official recruitment notification

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 consists of two stages: Elimination Test (MCQs) Practical (Skill) Test The selection list and waiting list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the Practical (Skill) Test and merit.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat High Court Wireman Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: General Knowledge Gujarati and English Language Knowledge Computer Knowledge Wireman Trade Knowledge The MCQ question paper will be in Gujarati language, although technical terms may be provided in English. PwBD Candidates: Minimum 45% Marks Other Candidates: Minimum 50% Marks Candidates qualifying in the elimination test will be considered for the next stage of the recruitment process. To be included in the selection list/waiting list, candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in the practical test: PwBD Candidates: Minimum 45% Other Candidates: Minimum 50%

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for application and document verification: Recent passport size photograph Birth certificate or school leaving certificate ITI Wireman qualification certificate and mark sheet Wireman work experience certificate Caste certificate (if applicable) Non-creamy layer certificate for SEBC candidates (if applicable) EWS certificate (if applicable) PwBD certificate (if applicable) Ex-Serviceman documents (if applicable) Government employee NOC (if applicable) Valid identity proof The notification specifies that candidates called for document verification must bring original certificates along with self-attested copies.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the HC OJAS portal within the prescribed dates. Visit the official HC OJAS website. Open the Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026 application link. Read the official notification carefully. Check eligibility criteria before applying. Complete the online registration process. Fill in personal details, educational details and experience details. Upload required documents and photograph. Pay the application fee according to category. Submit the application form. Save the confirmation number and take a printout for future reference. The notification advises candidates to complete the online application before the last date to avoid technical issues due to server load.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Wireman (Group-C) post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Wireman course from an Industrial Training Institute (ITI), along with knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi, English and computer knowledge as prescribed by the Government.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of Gujarat High Court Wireman?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a Pay Matrix salary of ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31 August 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Gujarat High Court Wireman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Elimination Test (MCQs) and Practical (Skill) Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in Gujarat High Court Wireman Exam 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. There will be negative marking of 0.33 marks for each wrong answer in the MCQ test.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Full Time job position. It offers a stable and regular employment opportunity within the Gujarat High Court.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply offline?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is exclusively online. Offline applications will not be accepted. Ensure you complete the process via the official portal.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the detailed notification PDF?
faq.answer: The detailed notification PDF for the Gujarat High Court Wireman (Group-C) recruitment is available for download. You can find the link in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
